reviews.text: I've been using this for a while, and I really like it. The formula is lightweight, comfortable to wear, and gives my makeup a smooth, flawless look. I would definitely purchase it again
reviews.zh: 用咗一排，真係好鍾意。質地輕身，搽得好舒服，令成個妝望落去好滑好貼。一定會再買。

reviews.text: very creamy and easy to apply, immediately become liquid in texture. colour is nice but a bit more hot pink then expected. relatively long lasting as well.
reviews.zh: 好 creamy 又易推，一上皮膚就即刻變成液體狀。顏色靚但比預期中更加 hot pink。持久度都算幾好。

reviews.text: I like that the pigmentation isn’t crazy, so it’s good for people who aren’t makeup pros. Love the colour, v suitable for summer
reviews.zh: 鍾意佢顯色度唔算誇張，所以唔係化妝高手嘅人都啱用。好鍾意呢個顏色，超啱夏天。

reviews.text:
I really like this product. It is easy to use and looks very nice on the skin.
Overall, I'm happy with this product and would buy it again. I recommend it if you want simple and pretty makeup.
reviews.zh:
我真係好鍾意呢個產品。用起上嚟好方便，上皮膚睇落好靚。
整體嚟講，我對呢個產品好滿意，會再買。如果你想要簡單又靚嘅妝，我推薦呢個。

reviews.text: Unlike the original cream blush Lilybyred has, this product has a thinner blurry "sherbet" like feel, hence the name!!! It looks beautiful on top of the skin and it gives a filtered yet glowy look!!
reviews.zh: 同 Lilybyred 原有嘅 cream blush 唔同，呢個產品質地更薄、有種朦朧嘅「雪酪」感，所以先叫呢個名！！！搽上皮膚好靚，呈現一種濾鏡感但又帶水光嘅妝效！！

reviews.text: I didn’t really get on with this. It’s my first time buying a Korean blush but it was just too light even on my very fair skin. It didn’t look like anything.
reviews.zh: 我同呢個產品真係夾唔嚟。第一次買韓妝胭脂，但係就算我皮膚咁白都仲覺得太淡。搽咗等於冇搽。

reviews.text: super smooth and glittery, colour shows up well, perfect for a overlaying or base colour for your everyday look.
reviews.zh: 超滑又有閃，顏色顯色得好好，完美適合作為日常妝嘅疊加色或者底色。

reviews.text: The glitter doesn’t show up on the cheek but it’s still pretty. It is different from the original one as it’s more pigmented and the product feels smoother and more light as in it’s texture
reviews.zh: 閃粉喺面頰上唔算顯眼，但都幾靚。同原版唔同，呢個顯色度更高，質地更滑更輕。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
